claim: Accumulated GEE capabilities allowed the author to supervise implementation at increasing abstraction, summarized as co-coder, tech lead, and architect.
topology: Three open staircase shelves with a left upward capability arrow and aligned responsibilities at right.
bw_encoding: Light qualitative shading, open shelves, and upward arrow.
redesign: Matched the author reference with three open staircase shelves, accumulated GEE capability at left, aligned responsibilities at right, and MY ROLE centered over both. Qualitative light shading, no embedded figure number. Native and SVG proofs visually inspected; pending author approval.
alt: Three ascending staircase shelves show Co-coder with an ordinary repository; Tech lead with agent review, deterministic checks, ownership zones, and boundary rules; Architect with system models, traceability, and controls. A rising GEE-capability arrow identifies the accumulated models, checks, and controls. Aligned responsibilities progress from reading, judging, and admitting changes to directing work and resolving exceptions, then deciding system structure, consequential obligations, and strategy.
